scale0_equivalence.note: base vs base+--lora-scaled F:0 on frozen probes (temperature 0); byte-identical required

scale1_change.method: greedy stream + top-5 logprob deltas via /completion (temp 0, seed 42); constrained answer probes are deliberately NOT used for change detection (single-answer tasks hide distribution shifts)
scale1_change.vulkan_temp0_nondeterminism_note: top-logprob vectors are not bitwise repeatable within a server at temp 0 on Vulkan; repeatability is asserted on delta magnitude across fresh processes, not on exact vectors

no_silent_fallback.note: nonexistent adapter path -> server must never become healthy (base-only fallback refused)

cache_policy_identity.note: identical context/cache flags across W0-W3 (only --lora file differs)
